title: TemporalContext
description: Decoupled temporal context separating source event epoch, observer UI clock, and local collector timestamp.

absolute_event_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of origin event if system epoch is provided.

relative_source_offset.description: Relative stream offset (e.g. T+00:48:30) or step index (e.g. step: 15).

collector_time.description: Mandatory local wall-clock execution time when observer captured the observation.

published_or_observed_clock.description: Display timestamp or header clock visible on UI/dashboard at observation time.

clock_skew_seconds.description: Numeric delta in seconds between published clock and source event time.
